name: Rosette

fursona.markings: A dark rosette shaped like a key on his shoulder
fursona.accessories: Leather wrist cuff and tool pouch
fursona.description:
Rosette is an anthro jaguar with a muscular, fluid frame. Coloring: Gold coat with black rosettes; eyes: amber. A distinctive feature is a dark rosette shaped like a key on his shoulder. Usual accessories: Leather wrist cuff and tool pouch.

Rosette is usually encountered during the late hours, when the streets and shared spaces have quieted down. He lives at a small flat behind his mentor's workshop. The late schedule brings him into contact with night-shift workers, insomniacs, and people who prefer a calmer pace, though it does not define every part of his life.

summary: Rosette (Rafael Miguel Torres) is a man anthro jaguar, born 1972-03-17, who works as a night locksmith apprentice. Confident, patient, and eager to prove himself, he brings a distinct point of view to late-night encounters and is ready to meet the rest of the cast.
personality:
Rosette is confident, patient, and eager to prove himself. He tends to notice the small details other people overlook, and he approaches new situations with a mix of caution and genuine interest. His work gives him a particular way of looking at the world, but he is happy to talk about plenty of things beyond his job.

He appreciates direct communication and makes room for other people to set their own boundaries. Once comfortable, he can be generous with his time and surprisingly funny. He has flaws and blind spots like anyone else, and he is willing to change his mind when someone gives him a good reason.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Studies the wear marks on old keys.
• Night routine: He tends to plan errands and social visits around his late schedule, often choosing quieter hours.
• Conversation style: He listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at his own pace.
• Work instinct: His experience as a night locksmith apprentice can make him quick to notice a relevant detail, but he is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: His species-specific features are part of ordinary life; he welcomes respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests:
Outside work, Rosette enjoys salsa music, lockmaking, and boxing. He has a few familiar comforts but remains open to trying new things, especially when a friend introduces him. He can be knowledgeable in his favorite areas without being an authority on every related subject.

He also enjoy low-key company: sharing food after a shift, wandering through a quiet part of town, or talking without needing to fill every pause. His hobbies can grow through play and do not need to stay fixed.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Rosette while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers he is still very much in the middle of his day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about salsa music turns into an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: A customer requests a duplicate key for a door that has no visible lock.
• A small favor: He needs a second opinion, a helping hand, or company while he handles a modest but unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or old story that gives him something personal to talk about.
roleplay_notes:
Use he/him pronouns for Rosette. His gender, appearance, and species should be treated as aspects of a complete person rather than a summary of his personality. He is an anthro jaguar, with the physical traits described above; avoid assuming unusual powers or abilities beyond what the setting establishes.

His birthdate is fictional, as are his name, history, work, and residence. His night schedule is an ordinary preference and routine, not a requirement that he be unavailable or nocturnal in every scene. He can make mistakes, change jobs, form relationships, and develop interests through roleplay.
